method.brightness: Mean Rec.709 luma of gamma-encoded RGB on a 0–255 scale. Center brightness uses the middle 60% in each axis. Shadow fraction is the share of sampled pixels below luma 32.
method.sharpness: Variance of the four-neighbor Laplacian of luma (squared luma units) at the same 640 px sample size. Texture, noise and compression affect the score; visual review decides the final selection.
method.darknessGate: Mean luma < 53, or mean < 73 and >54% deep shadow, or center luma < 49 and >40% deep shadow.
method.resolutionGate: Long edge at least 1440 px and short edge at least 900 px. Preferred desktop full-bleed landscape is at least 1600 × 900. The Columbus portrait hero is 1440 × 1920 and uses a separate desktop focal crop.
method.selection: Passing photos were shortlisted for relevance, visible work, crop suitability and distinct content. Limits apply to these backgrounds only.

qualityAudit.scope: Original 408-photo quality audit. The six supplied 1024-pixel expedition images are used in filmstrip tiles.

proposedPlayback.imageRendering: Use subject-anchored cover crops with the supplied focal points; review desktop and mobile crops, especially the Columbus portrait. Use contain in the full-screen lightbox.
proposedPlayback.foreground: Use translucent dark graphite behind cards only. Leave desktop margins and periodic full-width showcase breaks available for photo interaction; preserve visible breaks on mobile.
